The '''Devros system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Manda sector/Legends|Manda sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of [[Devros crystal]].<ref name="Simplicity">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050310a|text=Simplicity}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Devros crystal]]|system=Devros [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Devros system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square R-15.<ref name="TEA" />
